reason: r17 is the insertion build: it puts one cGUIObjScissorMask into the gauge row, under the row's root and over the bar, glow and edge, and writes the sharpness-ratio clip box into the mask's built rectangle from the draw walker. It carries the two storage expansions r14 lacked: the row's object array at instance+0xd8 (aliased at root+0xa0) is grown from 4 words to 5 through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator, and the row's draw block is reallocated through the root's own vtable slot 0x58 with main+0xa49b28's arithmetic, sized from the row+8 pair, with the record pointer at alloc + sequences * 12. The r14 run (NRO 6e061c70779cfb3a306835030256012e50dd19fdbeeae36d4d4635c331d35b8d) is why the insertion is shaped this way: the mask's built rectangle is rebuilt from the node's own quad while bit 1 of +0xa4 is set, which is why all 2512 of its lines read 0 0 W H, and main+0x5456e4 indexes the instance's array by the tree's node count + 1, which a 3-node tree with a 4-word map survived and a 4-node tree did not. r16 (NRO 415a822a2d3643efc1b5704c1e84814200be593c7922d297e85f535991acc0ed) ran on Eden the same day with the installed bytes matching: 93 plugin lines, zero guest exceptions, the bar reported visible, and the four map entries read out as controller, bar, glow and edge. r15 (NRO e90a6b54f2624c2cd6ae07b2567a14c794ebb7b34e068d841734e4541b18080f) ran clean and measured the published cache 192 bytes into the allocation, which main+0xa49b28's sizing fixes as a 72-byte record area = 9 records: r14's records fit, so its crash is the map alone. r17 has not been run. Not approved for distribution; r12 and r13 were packaged and never run.
runtime_test: NOT RUN: r17 inserts a scissor mask and changes what the game draws (the receipt records drawing_changed true). r16 ran once on Eden 2026-10-23 (installed bytes 415a822a2d3643efc1b5704c1e84814200be593c7922d297e85f535991acc0ed, 93 plugin lines, zero guest exceptions, bar reported visible); r15 ran clean the same day; r14 ran once and failed as reported.

limitations: r4 has no runtime test; its lines, the 320-sample budget and the absence of any drawing change are static results.
r2 was built and never run; r3 was run once on Eden and is recorded.
r14 was run once on Eden and failed as reported: the gauge was clipped away from the insertion and the game crashed at the quest end. Its log is the evidence, and the insertion is removed in r15.

r15 was run once on Eden and drew the gauge normally for 740 seconds with no exception; its facts line printed tree_nodes 3 against 4 objects, and its object-list fields were read from the wrong object (the controller's owner field), which is what r16 fixes.

r16 changes nothing on screen: it reads game memory and logs. No drawing, no gauge change, and no cleanup claim (the root-destructor hook fired zero times in the three sessions that logged it). Its Eden run ended in Eden's own shutdown records (maxwell_3d Critical asserts, ForceStop, host SIGSEGV) with zero guest exceptions.
the game's destructor is assumed to free the map block r17 publishes through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator; that free has not been observed, and r17 frees the old 4-word block itself
The per-weapon tier tables live in RomFS weapon data and are not read in this workspace: no weapon data file is extracted here.
The gauge itself is not part of r4.

r17's insertion, its grown map, its reallocated draw block (root vtable slots 0x58/0x5c) and its per-frame rectangle write at mask+0xb0..+0xbc are all unrun; the mask's teardown is unproven, since the root-destructor hook fired zero times in the three sessions that logged it
